picks.title: Ogilvy and CAA launch partnership to clone celebrity talent for AI ads
picks.rationale: New product launch (Echo): consent-first licensing of AI digital doubles of CAA talent for ads, a concrete new way to cast and produce AI ad creative.
picks.excerpt: Ogilvy and CAA launched Echo, a consent-first partnership that lets brands license AI-generated digital doubles of CAA talent such as Terry Crews for ads across the web.

picks.title: Google Ads MCP server gains 4 write tools, still can't change budgets
picks.rationale: Concrete release (v0.0.6): AI agents can now edit assets and labels in live Google Ads accounts by default, which directly changes how teams wire agents into campaigns.
picks.excerpt: Google's Ads MCP server v0.0.6 switched on four write tools for assets and labels in default installs, letting AI agents edit live accounts while budgets stay off-limits.

picks.title: Meta’s AI ads included unapproved discounts
picks.rationale: Meta's automated creative showed discount offers advertisers had switched off, a pricing/promotion guardrail failure every Advantage+ advertiser should audit.
picks.excerpt: Reports found Meta's AI-powered ad tools displayed discount offers to customers even when advertisers had promotions turned off, raising questions about guardrails on automated ad creative.

picks.title: "가짜 의사가 화장품 추천" 했다간…K뷰티, AI 광고 검수 재정비
picks.rationale: Amended Cosmetics Act takes effect on the 27th, explicitly banning AI-generated fake doctors/experts in cosmetics ads; K-beauty brands are rewriting AI ad review rules.
picks.excerpt: 개정 화장품법이 27일 시행되면서 AI로 만든 가짜 의사·전문가가 효능을 설명하는 화장품 광고가 명시적 금지 대상이 되고, K뷰티 업계가 AI 광고 내부 검수 기준을 재정비하고 있다.

picks.title: Google Ads AI-Generated Summaries Above & Within Search Ads
picks.rationale: New Google test: an AI summary of all advertisers' ads above the sponsored block plus per-ad AI summaries, rewriting what searchers actually read of your ad copy.
picks.excerpt: Google is testing an AI-generated summary above the block of sponsored results that summarizes all advertisers' ads, plus AI summaries beneath each ad description.
